# Desire

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Desire>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)

An intentional mode of wanting without commitment — the agent would welcome the goal's satisfaction but has not committed to pursuing it (UFO-C: desire). Inheres in exactly one agent ([`gmeow:intentBearer`](../properties/gmeow-intentBearer.md)). Promote a [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) to an [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) by minting the [`Intention`](gmeow-Intention.md) and suppressing the [`Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md)'s tenure — never by mutation ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Desire`](gmeow-Desire.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
